candidates.title: Approach, My Soul, the Mercy Seat (Hymn 414)

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Approach my soul the mercy seat
Where Jesus answers prayer
There humbly fall before His feet
None can perish there
Your promise is my only plea
With this I venture nigh

lyrics.label: Bridge
lines: You call out, burdened soul
Stir thee and judge, O Lord

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: Bow down beneath a Lord of sin

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: Satan sorely pressed by wars within
Fears within and wars without

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: I come to Thee for rest
Be Thou my shield and hiding place
A shelter near Your side
I lay my fears before Your face
And tell Him I have died
O wondrous love
To bleed and die
To bear the cross and shame
Guilty sinners such as I
Might plead Your gracious name
